name: Contractors with no website
description: Home-service contractors are often small operations without a web presence — an easy no-website lead list.

name: Restaurants rated under 4.0
description: Restaurants with room to improve their online reputation are a classic reputation-management pitch.

name: New businesses (low review count)
description: Very few reviews usually means recently opened — good timing for an early-outreach offer.

name: Dentists and orthodontists
description: Google's Places API doesn't separate orthodontists from dentists — both are tagged "dentist".

name: Auto repair shops
description: Independent auto shops competing against dealership service centers.

name: Gyms and fitness studios
description: Local gyms and studios — a dense, easy-to-canvas category in most metro areas.

name: Law firms
description: Solo practitioners and small firms are usually the most responsive to outreach.

name: HVAC and plumbing
description: High-ticket home services with steady year-round demand.

name: Salons and spas
description: Personal-care businesses, typically local and independently owned.

name: Real estate agencies
description: Independent agencies and small brokerages, not the national franchises.
